figurative_meaning_en: Royal throne; seat of the oppressor
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে মসনদে বসে সবাইকে আদেশ দিত।
দিল্লীর মসনদ শোষণের প্রতীক হয়ে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: He sat on the masnad issuing orders to everyone.
The masnad of Delhi has become a symbol of oppression.
history: Refers to the historical throne in Delhi, symbolizing Mughal imperial power and later colonial exploitation.
note: Derived from Persian 'masnad', commonly used in contexts of Indian subcontinental history.
